messages:
Samir Patel: Hey infra team — onboarding tenant 'acme-ml' (AWS acct 123456789012). We need quota increases for p5.24xlarge, p4d.24xlarge and g5.48xlarge in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-2. Steady concurrency ~8-12 GPUs, occasional bursts to 24. Also hit ENI and vCPU soft limits in eu-west-1 previously, so please request ENI, "Elastic GPU" limits, and EBS throughput bump where needed. Can someone open support cases?

Maria Kim: Thanks Samir. Can you paste expected vCPU and ENI numbers per AZ + any launch template details? AWS usually asks for exact instance counts per AZ and whether we need p4d/p5 in single AZ or spread.

Samir Patel: Quick numbers: target for eu-west-1 = p5: 8, p4d: 4, g5: 12 across 3 AZs (spread if possible). vCPU request: 1536. ENIs: request 200. ap-southeast-2 mirror = p5:4, p4d:2, g5:6; vCPU 640; ENIs 100. Launch templates use ENA + gp3.

Alice Zhou: I'm on it — opening parallel AWS support cases. Will request ENI + EC2 G-type quotas and describe our dedicated fleet use case. I'll loop in account team for expedited review.

Alice Zhou: Created cases: eu-west-1 case# 11234567890, ap-southeast-2 case# 11234567901. Filed business justification: "Production inference fleet for Redwood customer — predictable throughput, SLAs, security isolated VPC." Pinged TAM.

Jonathan Reyes: FYI if AWS pushes back on p5 availability, we can suggest p5->p4d fallback in routing policy and pre-warm nodes in one AZ. Also check subnet sizes — /20 per cluster might be needed because of ENIs.

Samir Patel: Good call. Add subnet /20 note to cases. Also question on cost center — do we put this under "acme-ml" or central infra billing? Need to know before they approve.

Maria Kim: Put under infra-cloud-bill (internal charge) and tag resources with tenant:acme-ml. I'll update the cases.

InfraBot: [automated] Support case 11234567890 (eu-west-1) status: Case created. Last update: 2026-03-18 10:12 UTC. Assigned to: AWS Account Team.

Alice Zhou: AWS replied asking for AZ breakdown and whether these are burst vs sustained. I replied: sustained 8-12, burst up to 24 for short windows (<=2 hours), and that we can accept partial increases while they validate capacity.

Samir Patel: Also adding note — network ENI bump is critical, we hit Pod networking limits during multi-tenant tests last week. If they ask for metrics I can paste the perf logs.

Maria Kim: Please attach 2026-03-12 perf logs and the rollout plan to both cases. I'll be the contact for follow-up.

InfraBot: [automated] Support case 11234567901 (ap-southeast-2) status: Case created. Last update: 2026-03-18 10:18 UTC.

Alice Zhou: AWS responded to ap-southeast-2 asking for timeline. I gave target date 2026-04-01 for production cutover; requested accelerated review.

Jonathan Reyes: If AWS limits AZ spread, we should plan for canary in single AZ + automatic fallback in routing policy to hosted models. I'll draft a fallback playbook.

Samir Patel: Thanks all. Please paste case links here once we have work items. I'll prep the perf logs and subnet sizes. :thumbsup:

Alice Zhou: Will update thread with case URLs and next steps.

InfraBot: [automated] Update: Case 11234567890 moved to "service team review". Estimated response TTL 48h.

Samir Patel: Noted. If we get partial quota granted (e.g., p5 only in eu-west-1), we'll queue deploys accordingly.

Maria Kim: Logging action items: 1) Attach perf logs (Samir), 2) Subnet /20 request added (Alice), 3) Billing tag decision (Maria) — I'll update cases.

Alice Zhou: Closing loop for now. Will post case URLs and final quota numbers when available.
